new_libraries.name: BlueGraysIoT
new_libraries.author: Yunus Emre Eke <info@bluegrays.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Control ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico W boards from the BlueGrays app over a secure WebSocket.
new_libraries.paragraph: Switches, sliders, colors and live sensor values with charts in the BlueGrays mobile app. TLS with bundled root certificates, automatic Wi-Fi and server reconnects, rate limiting and state restore after a power cut. The BlueGrays app generates the code. The device key travels only in the connection header and is never printed.

new_libraries.name: MicroTaskMonitor
new_libraries.author: MicroTask Monitor Contributors
new_libraries.sentence: Universal embedded system monitoring and diagnostics library inspired by Windows Task Manager.
new_libraries.paragraph: Real-time monitoring of RAM, heap, CPU, storage, temperature, power, RTOS tasks, network, uptime and performance profiling across AVR, ESP32, ESP8266, STM32, RP2040 and SAMD microcontrollers, with JSON/CSV telemetry, alerts, history and a modular transport layer.

library.name: ESP32-targz
library.author: tobozo <tobozo@noreply.github.com>
library.sentence: A library to compress/decompress tar+gzip archives.
library.paragraph: Archive a directory to tar.gz, extract tar.gz to a filesystem or stream, gzip webserver responses on the fly, perform OTA updates from compressed binary.

library.name: Pinscope
library.author: Filip Code <hello@pinscope.dev>
library.sentence: Reach your ESP32's web server from anywhere, with live logs, crash reports and OTA updates, in 9.4 KB of RAM.
library.paragraph: One outbound connection to the Pinscope service gives the device's own web server an HTTPS address and carries its logs, metrics, crash reports and firmware updates. No port forwarding, no TLS library on the device. Needs a Pinscope account (three devices free).

library.name: ProtoCentral HealthyPi 5
library.author: ProtoCentral Electronics
library.sentence: Dual-core NEXT runtime and board support for the ProtoCentral HealthyPi 5 (RP2040).
library.paragraph: Encapsulates the production HealthyPi 5 NEXT dual-core AMP architecture for the arduino-pico core: core1 does lossless 128 SPS acquisition (MAX30001 + AFE4400) into a lock-free ring while core0 runs a broker, per-sink queues, a built-in OpenView 2 streamer, 1 Hz telemetry and a hardware watchdog. Includes board.h, the canonical pin map for HealthyPi 5 revisions 5.2-5.7, and auto-detects the on-board temperature sensor (MAX30205 or AS6221). Requires the arduino-pico FreeRTOS variant (include <FreeRTOS.h> in the sketch).
depends: ProtoCentral AFE4490 PPG and SpO2 boards library

library.name: ProtoCentral MAX30001
library.author: ProtoCentral Electronics <support@protocentral.com>
library.sentence: Driver for the Analog Devices MAX30001 ECG and bio-impedance (respiration) AFE on the ProtoCentral MAX30001 Breakout.
library.paragraph: Reads single-lead ECG at 128/256/512 SPS and bio-impedance (BioZ) respiration at 64 SPS over SPI, with the chip's hardware R-to-R heart-rate detector, per-electrode DC lead-off detection, FIFO interrupts on INTB, and configurable gain and filters. Includes a ProtoCentral OpenView streaming example. Every example fits on an Arduino Uno. For research and education only - not a medical device.
